channel.title: The Apparently Times
channel.description: Satirical newspaper from Gainesville, Florida. We reported it first. We also made it up.

item.title: OpenAI Ends Cursor Access After SpaceX Deal; Promises Affected Developers Support Group. Asks It To Take Notes
item.dc:creator: The Apparently Times
item.description: Satire: OpenAI ends Cursor access after a SpaceX deal and promises affected developers a support group — then asks it to take notes.

item.title: New Publication Launches With Full Staff of Two People and One Model That Will Not Stop Pitching Headlines
item.dc:creator: The Apparently Times
item.description: Satire: The Apparently Times launches in Gainesville with a staff of two people and one model that will not stop pitching headlines.

item.title: Florida Schools Instructed To Call Lake Ontario “Lake America,” Teachers Ask If Hudson River Is Now Also Involved
item.dc:creator: The Apparently Times
item.description: Satire: Florida schools are told to call Lake Ontario “Lake America,” and teachers ask whether the Hudson River is next.

item.title: National Hurricane Center Clarifies Tropical Storm Dolly Has Nothing To Do With Dolly Parton, Country Immediately Unconvinced
item.dc:creator: The Apparently Times
item.description: Satire: The National Hurricane Center clarifies Tropical Storm Dolly is unrelated to Dolly Parton. The country is immediately unconvinced.

item.title: Grand Theft Auto VI Preview Lands; Employers Quietly Mark September As Lost
item.dc:creator: The Apparently Times
item.description: Satire: Grand Theft Auto VI preview footage lands and employers quietly mark September as a productivity loss.

item.title: Church Adds 8:15 Service For Members Who Have To Leave The 9:00 Service Early
item.dc:creator: The Apparently Times
item.description: Satire: A Gainesville church adds an 8:15 service for members who historically leave the 9:00 service early for Publix.
